sourceBinding: Launcher binary hash equals the clean package receipt.

checks: Created the first Super Admin and rejected unauthenticated project access
Started packaged service and served shipped web assets without Go or Node compilation
Created a real Git project, saved brief/design and generated LUCI.md
Recovered configured project, brief and drawing after a clean process restart
Rejected a foreign browser origin at the shipped control API
Verified shipped launcher ownership, account recovery, reuse and cleanup (7 outcomes)

checks.name: Shipped launcher started its own loopback service and exposed only privately proven owner access
Private launcher proof created a distinct account and recovered the original owner without changing saved work
Closing a second verified launcher preserved the already running service
Another state directory failed private proof verification without resetting data or stopping the service
Normal launcher close removed its proof and listener while retaining project data
Restart rotated private proof and retained the recovered account and saved project
Launcher output contained no owner proof, bootstrap token, password or bearer

launcher.scope: Actual shipped launcher and service; explicit disposable profile, no browser opening or native GUI.

limitations: Linux only; no Windows execution, native GUI or browser-polish claim.
No model calls or Docker acceptance.
